FN-8418MH2-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 527
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative James Lomax
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 03/16/2026
House Bill 527 as introduced could decrease income tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund by
an estimated $37.4 million annually for Fiscal Years 2026 through 2028 by allowing an
individual to claim an income tax deduction up to $1,000 of qualified overtime compensation
for tax years 2025 through 2027.

FN-8418MH2-3
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 527
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Representative James Lomax
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/03/2026
House Bill 527 as passed the House of Representatives could decrease income tax receipts to
the Education Trust Fund by an estimated $37.4 million annually for Fiscal Years 2027 through
2029 by allowing an individual to claim an income tax deduction, up to $1,000 of qualified
overtime compensation, for tax years 2026 through 2028.
This bill could also decrease sales and use tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund by an
estimated $45.8 million and the State General Fund by estimated $159,000, for fiscal year 2026
by suspending the state portion of the sales and use tax levied on food for the period beginning
May 1, 2026 and ending June 31, 2026.
